Job description:
Mirkagims invites motivated and capable interns to cooperate in the production and animation of images (using artificial intelligence). Skills you will acquire during this period: Production and animation of animated images using artificial intelligence, collaboration in producing visual references using artificial intelligence tools, assisting in the development and stabilization of the project's visual style through artificial intelligence tools, researching and examining new artificial intelligence tools to optimize the production process. Expected conditions and skills: Initial familiarity with AI-based image generation tools, interest in fantasy, mythological, and artistic content creation, sense of responsibility, ability to learn quickly, research skills, direct interaction with the art director and design team to support various production stages, full-time and regular presence, familiarity with editing, design, animation, comics, or motion graphics is an advantage. Advantages: Collaboration on a creative project with the potential to expand into game development and multimedia production areas, opportunity to enter a stable career path in the field of artificial intelligence, practical learning and teamwork experience in a professional environment, possibility of continued cooperation after the internship ends. Internship Details: Duration: Approximately 3 months (changeable, depending on individual learning speed and progress), starting from the second month with daily wages and working hours: Saturday to Wednesday 8 to 17 (flexible working time), Location: Tehran, Haft Howz Square.

Company description:
Mirkagimes is a game development startup that started at the beginning of the year 1402. The goal of this studio is to create attractive and innovative experiences for players. By utilizing a specialized team, it designs and produces diverse games that have received positive feedback from the audience. Mirkagimes focuses on quality, creativity, and alignment with current trends to become one of the key players in the gaming industry of Iran and the world.
